summary: Frontend-only regression and enhancement verification completed for timeline storytelling + telemetry + era immersion. All requested functional checks passed on public URL, including rapid-interaction uniqueness, reduced-motion behavior, route determinism, and viewport overflow matrix.

Reduced-motion path correctly suppresses timeline scan beam rendering (scan_count=0).
Production build compiles successfully via `yarn build` with no compile errors.
